description: The file is a shell script for platform upgrade procedures in an embedded Linux/OpenWRT environment. It contains functions for preparing, removing, and updating boot and UBI configurations, as well as specific upgrade routines for different device models.

methods.name: xiaomi_initramfs_prepare
methods.description: Prepares initramfs for Xiaomi devices by identifying partition indices and formatting relevant MTD devices.

methods.name: remove_oem_ubi_volume
methods.description: Removes an OEM volume from UBI, given the volume name.

methods.name: linksys_bootconfig_set_primaryboot
methods.description: Sets the primary boot configuration for a given partition.

methods.name: linksys_bootconfig_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Prepares U-Boot environment variables before firmware upgrade for certain Linksys models.

methods.name: linksys_mx_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Prepares environment variables related to boot partitioning for specific Linksys MX devices before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Stub function that always returns success, used as a check before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific preparations prior to upgrade, e.g., Xiaomi devices.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade handler that executes device-specific upgrade routines based on the board name.
